cues: Anita Desai, born in nineteen thirty seven, is one of India's leading writers in English.
Her mother was German and her father Bengali; she grew up in Delhi speaking German at home and Hindi outside, and English became her literary language.
Three of her novels were shortlisted for the Booker Prize.
This story comes from her collection Games at Twilight, from nineteen seventy eight.
